Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 20

“It is never born and never dies; having come to be, it never ceases to be. Unborn, eternal, everlasting, ancient — it is not killed when the body is killed.”

A chain of negations rather than a description. Krishna defines the self by everything that cannot happen to it, leaving Arjuna with something that resists being pictured — which may be the point.
